result: If I could change the world in one fundamental way, I would ensure that every child, regardless of their birthplace, has access to quality education, healthcare, and a safe, nourishing environment. Education unlocks potential, healthcare saves lives, and safety fosters growth—these are the building blocks of a thriving society. By guaranteeing these basics, we lay the groundwork for a more just, equitable, and innovative world where every individual can contribute meaningfully.
